requirements_summary: Customer is a payments-focused consumer fintech. Primary goal: reduce AHT and improve first-contact resolution in live contact center during peak spikes (Black Friday-like volumes). Wants agent assist + automated summarization for tickets and post-call notes, with deterministic citations and freshness metadata. Needs tool-calling hooks (ticket create/update, escalate, open refund flow) via secure API. Expected latency target for agent-facing suggestions: <=120ms median, p95 < 400ms. Throughput target: sustained 600 concurrent agents, burst to 2.5k. Cost sensitivity: high for hosted per-token; open to Dedicated reservation if lower unit cost. Model preference: open-but-verified LLMs, quantized variants acceptable. Must preserve PII and avoid exposing card data in embeddings.
